title: Moore hands Aquarius document to Benowitz in a supply closet

tellings.quote: And they go in the the the supply closet, he said. And he turned the radio up. And he gave him the thing and said, "I was told to give this to you. Take it with a grain of salt."

plain: In 1981, in Paul Bennewitz's office in Albuquerque, New Mexico, a man named Bill Moore is said to have led Bennewitz into a supply closet, turned a radio up, and handed him a paper known as the Aquarius document, saying: "I was told to give this to you. Take it with a grain of salt." Greg Bishop tells Michels this as he heard it about the two men. If it happened that way, it would mean the document was passed to Bennewitz on someone else's instructions, with a warning attached.
